rationale: The preferred-specification baseline OLS is reproduced essentially exactly: outputs/apptab4_ols.csv reports coef_d_tradeusch_pw = -0.1711 (se 0.0278, n=1444) for d_sh_empl_mfg, and the step-7 log notes an EXACT match to the original tab_ipw_manuf_exporters.scsv; this is -0.171 in the paper (well within 5%), and attenuated relative to the 2SLS -0.596 as the claim describes. However, the second component — the lagged-employment-weight OLS of -0.273 — was not produced: the replication_plan step-7 description and log both state 'the lagged-employment-weight variant of C8 is not shipped' because it requires rebuilding the CZ import-exposure variable with lagged weights, and only the pre-built workfile (not the exposure-construction code) is shipped. With one of two components matching exactly and the other having no produced evidence, the claim is partially supported.
